chunks: And from him, from his two brothers, from their father, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him saying: 'Ten feedings do not cause prohibition (of marriage).'
ai.seo_question: How many breastfeedings are required to make marriage prohibited in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the threshold for *radāʿah* (breastfeeding) to establish a permanent marital prohibition (*mahramiyyah*), specifying that exactly ten distinct feedings are required. This ruling is central to Shia jurisprudence, distinguishing it from other schools that may vary on whether the feedings must be before age two or if the number is strictly ten, thereby defining the scope of kinship ties through nursing.
